quickSummary: Chlorophyll consists of a hydrophilic magnesium-tetrapyrrole porphyrin head and a hydrophobic 20-carbon phytol tail. Chl a (essential pigment, bright blue-green) possesses a -CH3 group at C-3; Chl b (accessory, yellow-green) possesses a -CHO group. Both absorption and action spectra peak in blue (430–470 nm) and red (650–680 nm) wavebands. Accessory carotenoids protect Chl a from photo-oxidation. Antenna pigments channel photons radiationlessly to reaction centers (P680 in PS II, P700 in PS I) via Förster Resonance Energy Transfer (FRET).

conceptBreakdown.content:
Photosynthetic pigments are lipid-soluble compounds embedded in thylakoid membranes.

### Molecular Anatomy of Chlorophyll
• **Porphyrin Head**: Planar hydrophilic tetrapyrrole ring coordinating a central **$\text{Mg}^{2+}$** ion via four nitrogen atoms.
• **Phytol Tail**: Hydrophobic 20-carbon isoprenoid alcohol chain ($\text{C}_{20}\text{H}_{39}$) anchoring the molecule into the lipid bilayer.
• **Chl a vs Chl b**:
  - **Chlorophyll a** ($\text{C}_{55}\text{H}_{72}\text{O}_5\text{N}_4\text{Mg}$): Possesses a methyl group ($-\text{CH}_3$) at $\text{C}-3$; blue-green.
  - **Chlorophyll b** ($\text{C}_{55}\text{H}_{70}\text{O}_6\text{N}_4\text{Mg}$): Possesses a formyl group ($-\text{CHO}$) at $\text{C}-3$; yellow-green.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 2.1 Absorption Spectrum vs. Action Spectrum
conceptBreakdown.title: 2.1 Absorption Spectrum vs. Action Spectrum
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
ABSORPTION vs ACTION SPECTRA
                      
   ABSORPTION SPECTRUM ──► Graph plotting light absorption ($\text{A}$) vs wavelength ($\lambda$)
                            for purified isolated pigments.
                            
   ACTION SPECTRUM     ──► Graph plotting biological photosynthetic rate ($\text{O}_2$ evolution)
                            vs wavelength ($\lambda$) across intact tissue.
                            
   * Both spectra display primary peak maxima in BLUE ($430\text{--}470\text{ nm}$) 
     and RED ($650\text{--}680\text{ nm}$) wavebands of PAR ($400\text{--}700\text{ nm}$).
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Absorption Spectrum**: Quantifies photon absorption by purified pigment extracts across wavelengths.
• **Action Spectrum**: Measures relative photosynthetic efficacy (rate of $\text{O}_2$ evolution) across wavelengths in living leaves.
• Both curves closely match with prominent peaks in **Blue ($430\text{--}470\text{ nm}$)** and **Red ($650\text{--}680\text{ nm}$)** wavebands of PAR ($400\text{--}700\text{ nm}$).

conceptBreakdown.heading: 2.2 Förster Resonance Energy Transfer (FRET)
conceptBreakdown.title: 2.2 Förster Resonance Energy Transfer (FRET)
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
RESONANCE ENERGY TRANSFER (FRET)
                      
   Photon ($\hbar\nu$) ──► Antenna Pigment ──[FRET]──► Accessory Chl ──[FRET]──► Reaction Center (P680/P700)
                                                                                     │
   Primary Electron Acceptor ◄── Photo-Acts (Charge Separation $e^-$) ────────────────┘
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Antenna Complex**: Hundreds of accessory chlorophyll and carotenoid molecules harvest light and transfer excitation energy down an energetic gradient via non-radiative dipole-dipole resonance coupling (**FRET**).
• Energy converges onto the specialized reaction center chlorophyll a dimer: **P680** in PS II and **P700** in PS I, driving photochemical charge separation.
